data.name: Afolun
data.gender_notes: Afolun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Yoruba language, 'Afolun' means 'Majesty' or 'Reverence'. It is a name that is deeply rooted in the cultural traditions of the Yoruba people, and is often given to boys as a sign of respect and honor. The name Afolun carries the meaning “Majesty, Reverence” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Yoruba. Parents who choose Afolun usually hope their child will grow to embody majesty, reverence and live with faith, good character and purpose.
